item.title: 400 MTR passengers evacuated after power bank catches fire on train
item.description: Hong Kong’s MTR has evacuated around 400 people after a passenger’s power bank caught fire in a carriage during morning rush hour, filling the train with thick smoke. item.title: Hong Kong university student arrested for alleged doxxing after whistleblowing on academic integrity scandal
item.description: A Hong Kong university student who triggered a high-profile academic integrity scandal after casting doubt on the origins of a secondary student’s award-winning app has been arrested on suspicion of doxxing. Hailey Cheng, a City University student who is currently on leave, said on social media on Friday that she was arrested the day before […]

item.title: Hong Kong repeals controversial seat belt law as transport chief vows to consult public
item.description: The Hong Kong government has issued an official notice to repeal a controversial law requiring bus passengers to wear seat belts, which was widely derided by the public. “Effective today, there will not be a statutory requirement for [bus] passengers to wear seat belts,” Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said at a press […]

item.description: The Grand Emperor Hotel in Macau said it had ripped up the real gold bricks from its distinctive lobby floor and sold them for around US$13 million, cashing in on the metal’s market surge. item.title: Explainer: What to know about Hong Kong’s bus seat belt policy rollercoaster
item.description: Hong Kong’s controversial bus seat belt law will go down in history as one of the city’s shortest-lived regulations. It came into effect on January 25, but five days later, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan announced that the government would repeal it, citing “technical deficiencies” in the provision. item.title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 67
item.description: In the first month of 2026, the long-awaited national security trial of Tiananmen vigil activists and their historic group began.
